title: Dialog
description: Native dialog with a mixed-ink backdrop, language-defined surface styling and keyboard dismissal

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog: heading used as its accessible name unless aria-labelledby is supplied.

props.name: description
props.description: Dialog: optional description linked through aria-describedby unless overridden.

props.name: actions
props.description: Dialog: footer content, typically composed from DialogAction exports.

props.name: open
props.description: Dialog: controlled open state. Omit it to open or close through the native dialog ref.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Dialog: reports close and cancel requests. Update controlled open in this callback.

props.name: modal
props.description: Dialog: use showModal when opening; defaults to true. false uses the nonmodal show method.

props.name: inline
props.description: Dialog: in-flow, nonmodal specimen mode using the native open attribute; defaults to false.

props.name: wide
props.description: Dialog: wider container treatment; defaults to false.

props.name: confirm
props.description: DialogAction only: solid confirmation treatment; defaults to false.

props.name: type
props.description: DialogAction only: native button behavior; defaults to button.
